reviewScope: One of the three requested unchanged tasks. Exactly 8 candidate, 69 negative and 84 already-selected contexts accounted for; no fresh approval of the other two tasks or the other countries.
wholeTaskRead: Actual current examData requires numerical cylinder volume with units, geometric base-area-times-height explanation, actual compass-and-straightedge construction of both external tangents including auxiliary locus/contact points, and Thales/right-angle justification. The historical draft_v3 description-only task is not the reviewed task. Current mathematics: V=0.60288 m^3, auxiliary circle centre (7,3), radius 3, contact points (5.5,3 +/- 1.5 sqrt(3)); the four unchanged scoring steps total 7, threshold 4. The Nov1 independent content review case 9 approved the corrected content and explicitly did not approve scope.

officiallySupported: SH 2024 p.32: lengths/angles through constructions or geometrical theorems, including Thales.
p.33: cylinder volume/surface and geometrical relationships of solids; circle area and units.
p.40: actual hand constructions with compass/straightedge, perpendicular bisector and angle bisector.
p.41: proving and applying Thales; geometrical arguments.
notEstablishedAsOfficialSeparateRequirem: The whole general locus-selection contract cf8c including the stated range of loci.
The particular pair of tangents from an external point, 743e, and its whole point-tangent preparation 570d.
A universal SH class-8 examination or this fixed own task.
sourceDecision.ownerDelegatedDecision: Retain the already existing whole contracts as a bounded own extension applying the official geometric foundation. Locus intersection and right-angle constructions form a coherent next application after basic compass constructions and Thales. No new capability ID, copied official task, invented source row or learner elective choice is needed. The absence of a named tangent row alone is neither approval nor prohibition.
sourceDecision.optionalStatus: The source explicitly permits circumference-angle extension as differentiation (p.41); preserve that optional status. The external-tangent/locus extension is an own SkillPilot addition, not an officially designated compulsory or elective unit.
sourceDecision.oldExclusion: The explicit current SH exclusion is a real existing boundary; Nov1 retained it and did not review scope. This decision specifically replaces that boundary for the eight named complete contexts after the actions below. The exact historical motivation for the exclusion is not independently documented in the read artifacts and is not invented.

wholePreparation.actualAcquisition: In all six duration-specific SH views the four direct competencies are within the same middle band (G8 6/7/8; G9 7/8/9). Of all 44 support nodes, 33 are in band 5/6, eight in the middle band, one is the stage orientation and two remain stage-wide: 491e area-formula derivation and 57fb volume units. Mere target membership does not assign those last two an acquisition point.
wholePreparation.sequence: Earlier number/units/coordinate and construction basis; volume units and rectangle-volume understanding; same-band area formula reasoning and circle/Thales reasoning; point tangent and locus choice; external tangent; then this whole fixed task. The relation 570d -> 743e and the four direct demands remain unchanged.

actions: Allow this exact own task only in the eight named SH lower/cross-stage contexts. Keep all 69 SekII negatives and all existing whole target sets/IDs. No whole-state or phase-tag shortcut is sufficient.

Keep the middle-band acquisition placement, with own-task display label making its extension nature explicit; the old canonical J8 metadata is not evidence of an official SH J8 requirement. Do not claim an earlier fixed year within the band.

Make the source/own-extension distinction visible for the whole existing locus/tangent application corridor (cf8c, 743e, 570d and the broader circle-relations preparation 2134). Preserve the official compulsory Thales/basic-construction contracts and optional circumference-angle status. Do not fabricate exact source mappings for the extension. A label correction may preserve the existing reference IDs and memberships.

Place the already existing volume-unit competence 57fbbf31-9b8c-5408-9af5-fbc73acd12bb in the earlier units/volume basis and area-formula derivation 491e0858-e977-516e-a339-1cc2f9e9690f in or before the middle-band geometry sequence, retaining their whole current contracts. Their current stage-wide residual placement is not a proven year assignment.

Bind the current corrected task/source-review evidence rather than asserting the old draft_v3 description-only text is the current task. Keep task, solution, scoring, four requires and four coveredGoalIds unchanged.

Before activation verify the exact candidate target/role/path sets for all eight contexts, saved focus handling, no duplicate visible goal and the whole effective preparation acquisition order. Retain removed stored references and request explicit reselection where necessary; no whole-PC fallback or silent added targets.
